channel.title: The Soulstone Journal
channel.description: Notes on Shopify Plus conversion, store architecture and product data, written by Marin Gerov, an independent Shopify Plus developer in Amsterdam.

item.title: Shopify single theme vs multi-theme releases: keep one live theme, not a copy per campaign
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Shopify single theme vs multi-theme: keep one live theme as the only place content is edited, and use unpublished copies for code, not a duplicate theme per campaign.

item.title: Shopify merchandising for complex campaigns: how to run launches, gifts and members-only drops without breaking the store
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: How to set up Shopify merchandising for campaigns and promotions: give each product state one switch, keep cart and checkout rules in sync, and test the whole flow before launch.

item.title: Shopify Fall 26 Edition checkout: what is live before Black Friday
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Shopify Fall 26 Edition checkout: what is live before Black Friday. Payment tiles are rolling out; native custom fields and Apple Pay outside Safari are still coming soon.

item.title: Why did my Shopify conversion rate jump? Bot filtering and the session measurement update
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Why did my Shopify conversion rate jump? Bot filtering and the session measurement update from 21 to 23 September 2026 left bots out of session reports, so the rate rose while orders stayed the same.

item.title: What Shopify's AI channel checkout defaults are and how to change them
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: By default Shopify shares products with AI channels and runs direct checkout in Google, Meta and Copilot. Open Sales channels > Agentic, turn off Allow Shopify to manage for me, then set each channel.

item.title: How to opt out of Meta product browsing before the 28 Oct 2026 default
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: On 28 October 2026 Meta turns product browsing on for existing ads unless you opt out. Use the notice button, then check each ad in Ads Manager so a tap still opens your store.

item.title: How to add gift with purchase in Shopify
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: How to add gift with purchase in Shopify: the native Buy X get Y discount does not add the gift to the cart automatically. Set up Buy X get Y first, then theme or app auto-add if you need it.

item.title: How do I customize Shopify checkout with extensibility?
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Visible changes go in checkout UI extensions, logic goes in Shopify Functions, looks go in the branding API. What each can do, and what needs Plus.

item.title: No-nonsense Shopify development: take complexity out before you add more
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Most overblown Shopify stacks don't need another app or a rebuild. Find who writes what, use what Shopify already runs, and ship small. Four rules I work by, with two real cases.

item.title: How do I migrate to checkout extensibility after checkout.liquid and Additional scripts?
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: How to customize checkout with checkout extensibility after checkout.liquid deprecation: tracking moves to Customer events, visible changes move to UI extensions, and theme code never runs in checkout.

item.title: The price keeps reverting. The theme is not the problem.
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: A sale price came back overnight after a manual fix. How I traced the real writer in Shopify, and why I map every writer before touching code.

item.title: owner_type in checkout extension metafields: add it now, before 2027-01 blocks your deploy
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: From API 2026-10, checkout and customer account UI extensions can set owner_type on metafields. From 2027-01 it is required. The change and a repo check.

item.title: On premium Shopify stores, mobile speed is a conversion lever, not an IT metric
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Why Core Web Vitals quietly cap revenue on premium Shopify Plus stores, what actually slows them down, and the order to fix it in.

item.title: Most premium brands don't have a traffic problem. They have a conversion problem.
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Why established premium brands keep buying more attention to fix a problem that lives on the store, and how to tell the difference before you spend another euro on ads.

item.title: Replatforming is usually the wrong answer
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: When a premium Shopify Plus store feels broken, replatforming feels like the fix. It usually isn't. Here's how to decide between a rebuild and a re-architecture.

item.title: The anatomy of a product page that closes premium buyers
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: Premium customers decide fast. Here's what belongs above the fold on a high-end Shopify product page, and the order of information that turns intent into a sale.

item.title: The hidden cost of Shopify Plus app sprawl
item.dc:creator: Marin Gerov
item.description: How to reduce Shopify Plus app sprawl and speed up a slow store: a dozen well-intentioned apps become the reason the store is slow, fragile and expensive to change, and how to consolidate them without a replatform.
